## Background
This Github repository containing all of the code that is associated with the post-effect disturbances from Hurricane Hugo 1989. The purposes of this is to recreate the figure.

## Data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
source("../R/moving-average.R")

prm <- read_csv("../data/RioMameyesPuenteRoto.csv")
q1 <- read_csv("../data/QuebradaCuenca1-Bisley.csv")
q2 <- read_csv("../data/QuebradaCuenca2-Bisley.csv")
q3 <- read_csv("../data/QuebradaCuenca3-Bisley.csv")
```

## Methods
The analysis calculates the 9-weeks of moving averages from the chemistry measurments and plots these averages over a time period from 1988 to 1995.
```{r}
prm_1 <- prm |>
  select(Sample_Date, Sample_ID, `NH4-N`, `NO3-N`, Ca, Mg, K) |>
  filter(Sample_Date >= "1988-01-01" & Sample_Date < "1995-01-03")
```

```{r}
q1_1 <- q1 |>
  select(Sample_Date, Sample_ID, `NH4-N`, `NO3-N`, Ca, Mg, K) |>
  filter(Sample_Date >= "1986-05-16" & Sample_Date < "1995-01-03")
```

```{r}
q2_1 <- q2 |>
  select(Sample_Date, Sample_ID, `NH4-N`, `NO3-N`, Ca, Mg, K) |>
  filter(Sample_Date >= "1986-05-16" & Sample_Date < "1995-01-03")
```

```{r}
q3_1 <- q3 |>
  select(Sample_Date, Sample_ID, `NH4-N`, `NO3-N`, Ca, Mg, K) |>
  filter(Sample_Date >= "1986-05-16" & Sample_Date < "1995-01-03")
```
## Results

```{r}
average_prm_1 <- moving_average(prm_1)
```
